level1.title: Baby John Is Born
level1.story: Elizabeth had a baby boy. Everyone wanted to name him Zechariah, like his father. Zechariah wrote, "His name is John," and then he could speak again!

level2.title: His Name Is John
level2.story: Elizabeth gave birth to a son, and her neighbors and relatives rejoiced with her. On the eighth day they wanted to call him Zechariah after his father. His mother said, "Not so; but he shall be called John." They asked his father, and he wrote on a tablet, "John is his name," and at once his mouth was opened, and he praised God. The child grew and became strong in spirit, and lived in the desert until he appeared to Israel.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How did John prepare the way for Jesus?
level2.prayer: St. John the Baptist, help me point others to Jesus. Amen.
